content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Raipur
content_sections.text: AIIMS Raipur describes itself as an apex healthcare institute, established by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY). It is located at G. E. Road, Tatibandh, Raipur- 492 099 (Chhattisgarh). This walk-in is issued by its Academic Section for Senior Residents (Non Academic) under the Govt. of India Residency Scheme.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: AIIMS Raipur has 25 posts of Senior Resident-Non Academic (Group A) in the departments listed in Annexure-A of the notice. The total includes 1 post for PwBD, and the notice says the vacancies are provisional and subject to variation. Reservation for ST/SC/OBC candidates is as per Central Govt. rules, with 4% for PwBD candidates on a horizontal basis. EWS posts are not carried forward or considered as backlog if unfilled, so candidates of other categories may be allowed provisionally to apply; they will be considered as UR candidates only if the EWS seat is otherwise not filled. Only candidates who have been declared successful in their qualifying degree exam and will be completing or likely to complete their tenure on or before the date of walk-in-interview are eligible. If the result of the qualifying exam is declared after the walk-in date, the candidature will stand cancelled and no claim for selection will be considered. Age and other qualification/experience will be counted as on the date of walk-in-interview. The prescribed qualification is minimum; merely possessing it does not entitle a candidate to selection. The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each department. The upper age limit is 45 years, counted as on the date of walk-in-interview. For Ex-servicemen, the extra five years apply only if continuous service in the Armed Forces is not less than six months after attestation on the closing date. The relaxation is also available to ECOs/SSCOs who have completed their initial five years of Military Service. Candidates claiming this relaxation must produce a certificate in the prescribed proforma at the time of walk-in-interview. Ex-servicemen already in regular Central Govt. civil employment get the age relaxation for a higher post but are not eligible for Ex-servicemen reservation. The pay is Rs. 67,700/- (Level-11, Cell No. 01 As per 7th CPC) plus usual allowances including NPA (if applicable). The appointment is as per the Govt. of India Residency Scheme for a tenure period up to 3 years, and Senior Residents are entitled to leave at the rate of 2½ days for every completed month. The appointment can be terminated at any time, on either side, by one month's notice or one month's salary, or for failure to complete the period of three months to the satisfaction of the competent authority. The appointment is whole time; the appointee shall not accept any other assignment, paid or otherwise, nor engage in private practice of any kind during the contract. The competent authority may assign any duty as and when required, with no extra/additional allowances for it. The appointee is not entitled to Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion etc. or other benefits of regular Government Servants. content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The notice includes an Application Form for the post of Senior Resident (Non-acad) with a passport size self-attested colour photograph to be affixed. Self-attested photocopies may be annexed to the hard copy of the application, and the originals must be produced along with photocopies for verification at the walk-in. The form asks for these self-attested copies in this order: Certificate for Date of Birth (Class X or XII Certificate) MBBS/BDS Mark Sheets (All Semester) MBBS/BDS Degree Internship completion certificate Attempt certificates MCI/NMC/DCI State council registration MD/MS/DNB/MDS/PG Mark Sheet MD/MS/DNB/MDS/PG Diploma/Degree certificate SC/ST/OBC/PH certificate issued by the competent authority (if applicable) Experience (if any) No Objection Certificate (if any) Copies of any other relevant documents Candidates working in Central/State Government/Semi Government/Autonomous Institution must submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer at the walk-in. OBC-NCL candidates: OBC-NCL certificate (Annexure-A format) issued on or after 01.04.2026, based on the year 2025-26, plus a declaration that the candidate does not belong to the creamy layer. EWS candidates: EWS certificate (Annexure-C format) as per DoPT O.M. dated 31.01.2019, issued on or after 01.04.2026. SC/ST/OBC certificates (Annexure-A and B formats) must be issued by Tehsildar or above rank authorities. PwBD candidates: disability certificate from a duly constituted Medical Board of a State or Central Govt. Hospital/Institution, countersigned by the Medical Superintendent/CMO/Head of Hospital/Institution. Fee transaction details (UR/OBC/EWS candidates).

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report between 10:00 am and 11:00 am on 4 December 2026. Based on bio-data, the Search cum Selection Committee may short-list candidates for the walk-in-interview, or candidates may be asked to appear in a written examination if there is a large number of applicants. Short-listing may be done on the basis of educational qualification, experience etc. and/or criteria decided by the Competent Authority. If a large number of applications are received for any post, a Screening Test (computer based or offline) may be conducted, and its syllabus, scheme and method will be notified on the AIIMS Raipur website. Final selection will be made on the basis of the walk-in-interview, and the decision of the Executive Director & CEO, AIIMS Raipur is final. Names of shortlisted candidates and any Written Test and/or Skill Test schedule will be displayed only on the institute website, with no individual intimation.

faq.question: Q1. When is the AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident walk-in interview 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 4 December 2026 (Friday), with reporting time 10:00 am to 11:00 am.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident walk-in venue?
faq.answer: The venue is the Academic Section, 4th Floor, A block, New Admin Building, AIIMS Raipur, Tatibandh, G.E. Road, Raipur (C.G.) 492099.

faq.question: Q3. How many Senior Resident vacancies are there at AIIMS Raipur?
faq.answer: There are 25 posts (UR-10, OBC-7, SC-4, ST-2 and EWS-2), including 1 post of PwBD, across Anaesthesia, Biochemistry, three Dentistry specialties, Radio Diagnosis and Trauma & Emergency.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident (Non Academic)?
faq.answer: A Postgraduate Medical Degree viz. MD/MS/DNB/Diploma in the respective discipline from a recognized University/Institute is required; for Dentistry, a Postgraduate Degree i.e. MDS in the concerned specialty.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on the date of walk-in-interview, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 to 15 years for PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident (Non Academic)?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 67,700/- (Level-11, Cell No. 01 As per 7th CPC) plus usual allowances including NPA (if applicable).

faq.question: Q7. Are allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, usual allowances including NPA (if applicable) are paid on top of Rs. 67,700/-, but the appointee does not get Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity or other regular-employee benefits.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for the AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident walk-in?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1,000/- for General/OBC/EWS candidates and Nil for Women/SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-servicemen, paid through NEFT in online/digital mode only.

faq.question: Q9. How will AIIMS Raipur select Senior Residents?
faq.answer: Final selection will be made on the basis of the walk-in-interview; candidates may first be short-listed on bio-data or asked to take a written examination or Screening Test if applicants are many.

faq.question: Q10. Is the AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is under the Govt. of India Residency Scheme for a tenure period up to 3 years and can be terminated by one month's notice on either side.
